title: Tailwise Autoship Tenure and the Autoship Look-Back Window for Freight Service-Failure Refunds
content:
For the service-failure refund on a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase shipped by Large Item Freight Delivery, the Autoship look-back window is set by how long the customer's active Tailwise Autoship subscription has run, in whole months since its enrollment date.

| Active Tailwise Autoship subscription has run | Autoship look-back window |
|---|---|
| 36 whole months or more | The last 24 months |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months | The last 18 months |
| Fewer than 12 whole months, or no active Autoship subscription | The last 12 months |

**Reading the window.** A month counts as whole once the day of the month of the enrollment date is reached again. A shipment charge falls within the last 24, 18 or 12 months when fewer than that many whole months separate its date from today.

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical enrollment dates, today 2026-06-15)

| Enrollment of the active subscription | Whole months run | Look-back window |
|---|---|---|
| 2023-06-16 | 35 | Last 18 months |
| 2023-06-15 | 36 | Last 24 months |
| 2025-06-16 | 11 | Last 12 months |
| 2025-06-15 | 12 | Last 18 months |
| None active | - | Last 12 months |

The window is read from the enrollment date of the subscription whose status on the Tailwise Autoship record is active.
